summary: Learn alarm rationalization, lifecycle documentation and event-log monitoring. Improve alarm-flood response with practical course exercises. Enquire today.
lede: Process alarm management helps engineers, operators and process safety professionals document alarm decisions and monitor performance. The training covers alarm rationalization, priority and operator-response assignment, master alarm database records, event-log analysis and performance measures. Practical exercises include reviewing alarm floods, maintaining lifecycle records and prioritizing corrective actions in process operations.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who make, configure, respond to or govern process alarms and need a consistent method for documenting alarm decisions and tracking performance.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with process control, instrumentation or control-room operations is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for the event-log worksheet exercises; no specialist control-system software installation is required.
